pattern: Bookeeper 2.0 verify commands: Rust = `cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace`; JS = `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:2` (root scripts act only on packages/* and apps/*); OpenAPI = `UPDATE_OPENAPI=1 cargo test -p bookeeper-core --test openapi` then `npm run gen -w @bookeeper/api`. Linux needs libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libgtk-3-dev librsvg2-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev before any workspace cargo command.

Bookeeper 2.0 conventions: legacy trees server/ clients/ deploy/ are frozen 0.3, never edit. New code in crates/ apps/ packages/. Internal npm deps as "*". Apps use vite ^7 + vitest ^3 (vitest 3 does not support Vite 8), import defineConfig from 'vitest/config', tsconfig needs resolveJsonModule for @bookeeper/i18n. Rust builds must not require Node: build.rs writes a placeholder dist/index.html. Server router must keep ONE fallback (axum merge panics on two): JSON 404 under /api/, SPA elsewhere. Every user-facing error carries a stable snake_case error_code. Never use the word tenant: libraries = household, rooms = rooms.

Run shape bookeeper-2-0-fase-0: 10 modules, 9 tiers (one parallel pair m5||m6, rest serial because Cargo.lock/package-lock.json are shared), worktree isolation, sonnet workers ~1-5 min each, one reviewer per module plus 3-lens opus final review. 0 worker retries, 1 validation retry caused by orchestrator (shared cargo target dir). Workers needed an explicit `git reset --hard <HEAD>` because worktrees branched from the default branch, not current HEAD. Orchestrator applied ~8 small fix commits from review warnings between tiers; final review found 0 must-fix, 7 advisories. Tasks were pre-written as a TDD plan with exact interfaces, which is why workers passed first time.
